title: Build an LRU cache with generics
summary: Implement a typed least-recently-used cache with constant-time lookups, capacity clamping, recency refresh, and most-recent-first keys.
objectives: Implement a generic cache keyed by any comparable type.
Maintain recency across Get, Put, and update operations.
Evict the least recently used entry at capacity and report keys most-recent-first.
constraints: Keep the Cache type and the NewCache, Get, Put, Remove, Len, and Keys signatures.
Get must refresh recency on a hit and return the zero value plus false on a miss.
Put on an existing key updates the value and refreshes recency without evicting.
Keys must return most recently used first and never return nil.
Remove is a no-op for an absent key, and Len reports the current entry count.

examples.explanation: Get refreshes "a", so "b" becomes the least recently used and is evicted.

examples.input: cache := NewCache[string, int](2); value, ok := cache.Get("missing")
examples.explanation: A miss returns the value type's zero value and false.
Capacity below 1 is clamped to 1, so each new key evicts the previous one.
